Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Our distributed real-time media communications network requires an exhaustive architectural evaluation of ICE candidate gathering protocols, STUN server binding sequences, and relay media routing edges across native and web application clients. Under enterprise network configurations characterized by symmetric network address translation, restrictive corporate proxy firewalls, and carrier-grade NAT cellular gateways, media negotiation setup latencies frequently exceed four point two seconds. Developers must ensure that peer connection teardown routines release audio track buffers and cleanup WebGL video sink pipelines without leaking browser memory allocations during rapid reconnect cycles.

3. Session Description Protocol and Candidate Serialization Routines
Protocol encoding logic implemented in session description dot rs requires strict conformance to RFC 8445 specifications. Tag session description dot rs to inspect candidate attribute parsing for host, server reflexive, and relay candidate types. The parser must validate candidate priority calculation formulas, foundation token uniqueness, and component identification integers without truncating IPv6 address representations. In addition, the serialization harness must gracefully validate candidate transport types, distinguishing between UDP, TCP active, and TCP passive modes while discarding malformed candidate attributes from legacy SIP gateway peers.

Edge relay instances deployed across geographic regions terminate STUN and TURN allocations under high concurrency. Review turn config dot yaml in the deployment directory to verify authentication mechanisms, shared secret generation, and ephemeral credential lifetimes. The TURN configuration must enforce allocation bandwidth quotas of two megabits per second per stream and configure UDP buffer sizes to sixteen megabytes to prevent packet loss during burst video keyframe transmissions. The relay infrastructure must also balance traffic across diverse regional clusters using geographic DNS Anycast routing while preserving session stickiness during active media calls.

5. Gathering State Machine and Trickle ICE Signaling Optimizations
Traditional WebRTC implementations wait for complete ICE candidate gathering before exchanging SDP offer-answer envelopes, introducing unacceptable call setup latency over mobile cellular connections. The signaling gateway in gateway dot ts must fully implement Trickle ICE. Client endpoints should transmit initial SDP offers immediately following host candidate discovery, streaming subsequent reflexive and relay candidates asynchronously across WebSocket signaling channels. Furthermore, the signaling layer must implement exponential backoff retry schedules for candidate transmission acknowledgments, ensuring that transient network disconnects do not abort ongoing call negotiations.

Mobile client applications frequently transition between cellular radio data and local wireless networks during active voice calls. Verify that media payload encryption strictly enforces DTLS-SRTP key exchanges. The security boundary must also enforce certificate thumbprint pinning during peer negotiation and implement strict rate-limiting on unauthenticated STUN binding requests to mitigate distributed denial of service vectors.

8. Telemetry Dashboard, Quality of Experience Metrics, and Audit Sign-Off
Platform site reliability engineers must instrument Prometheus metrics tracking mean gathering duration, ICE failure ratios, and relay fallback percentages. Document all architectural findings in audit report dot md and obtain operational approval from network infrastructure leads before deploying client library updates.
